split_rule: Expand each initial-condition group with all four materials for its split. Keep every material variant of a group in one split; use seeds absent from v1. 16 train, 8 validation, 12 test scenes; 4/2/3 independent initial-condition groups.
numerical_reference: Independent dense RK4 at dt/4 and dt/8, compare at all horizons. Export dt/8 targets. No new physical-water validation; retain failed reports and refuse fitting if numerical checks fail.
blind_v2_features: The unchanged v1 nine initial centred position/velocity and known-gravity features, refitted on v2 training only.
material_v2_features: The same nine features plus stiffness times each centred position coordinate and viscosity times each centred velocity coordinate (six interactions). Affine in these 15 features, bilinear in raw material/state inputs; no simulator forces or future states.
targets: Unchanged v1 direct-horizon residuals: (x_t-x_0-t*v_0)/t^2 and (v_t-v_0)/t, six outputs per horizon at steps 1/10/50. No autoregressive rollout.
training: Use v1 weighted normalization and ridge solver; give each training scene equal weight and each particle equal weight within its scene. Four material variants per group imply equal group weight. Intercept unpenalized; no validation refit.
selection: Select one alpha per candidate across all horizons using the unchanged v1 validation score: sqrt(mean across scenes and horizons of ((position_rmse/t^2)^2+(velocity_rmse/t)^2)/2). Exact ties prefer larger alpha. Save both models before test scoring.
test_reporting: No winner-based activation or threshold. Report every scene/horizon; arithmetic mean of scene RMSEs per horizon, material condition and count. Primary contrast is material_v2 versus blind_v2, which share training data and selection budget. Frozen v1 is a separate unchanged reference.
paired_material_reporting: At identical initial state, subtract base-material predictions/targets from each other test material for the same group and horizon. Report per-coordinate RMSE of the predicted change versus true change, and magnitude of the true change. These contrasts share three geometries and are not independent samples.
constraints: No test targets in normalization, fitting or selection.
No changes to v1 sources, manifest, models or raw evidence.
No walls, neural/JEPA runtime, physical calibration, conservation guarantee or resource-performance claim.
Any longer autoregressive evaluation requires a separate predeclared protocol; it is not part of this direct-horizon slice.
